defs.def: detailed and exact 明确的；具体的

ex.s: Each mode of transport has its specific fuel needs.
ex.t: 每种交通方式都有其特定的燃料需求。

ex.s: In order to make surely all of us are in good health, and she makes specific plans for us.
ex.t: 为了确保我们所有人都健康，她为我们制定了具体的计划。

ex.s: So why should we try to set specific goals?
ex.t: 那么我们应该为什么要设定具体的目标呢？

ex.s: The Chinese Ministry of Agriculture finds that between 2005 – when the government   68   (start) a soil – testing program   69   gives specific fertilizer recommendations to farmers – and 2011, fertilizer use dropped by 7.7 million tons.
ex.t: 中国农业部发现，在2005年（政府___68___ start一项为农民提供具体施肥建议的测土配方项目）至2011年间，化肥使用量下降了770万吨。

ex.s: Not only can you post specific questions, but you can broaden your knowledge by reading posts from other English learners around the world.
ex.t: 你不仅可以发布具体问题，还可以通过阅读来自世界各地其他英语学习者的帖子来扩展你的知识。

ex.s: Refer to these words for further help: adaptation harmony strength regeneration beauty reliance simplicity respect 2 Go online to find specific examples supporting the inspirational power of nature.
ex.t: 参考这些词语以进一步帮助：适应和谐强度再生美容依赖简便 尊重 2 上线寻找支持自然灵感力的具体实例。

defs.def: connected with one particular thing only 特定的

ex.s: But so far that is only true for the specific tasks for which the systems have been designed.
ex.t: 但到目前为止，这仅适用于那些系统被专门设计来完成的特定任务。

ex.s: To identify their specific thinking patterns.
ex.t: 为了识别他们特定的思维模式。

ex.s: Whether big or small, what all our choices have in common is that they leads to specific consequences Once we make a decision, in most circumstances, there is no going back.
ex.t: 无论大小，我们所有的选择都有一个共同点，即它们会导致特定的后果一旦我们做出决定，在大多数情况下，就无法回头。

ex.s: Alvaro Luna, a professor of electrical engineering, said that the system is innovative in so far as it allows for recycled energy to be redirected to specific local uses — in this case powering electric cars parked nearby.
ex.t: 电气工程教授Alvaro Luna表示，该系统的创新之处在于它能让回收的能量转向特定的本地用途——在这里就是为停在附近的电动汽车供电。

ex.s: If TMS is applied to a specific part of your brain behind your forehead that is particularly important for decision-making, you suddenly like different kinds of art.
ex.t: 如果TMS被应用到你前额后面的某个特定的大脑部分，对于决策特别重要，那么你突然喜欢不同的艺术。

ex.s: The lighting-up of specific brain areas.
ex.t: 特定大脑区域的激活。

ex.s: Each week, participants will be asked to complete a topic﹣specific reflection task.
ex.t: 每周，参与者将被要求完成一项特定主题的反思任务。

ex.s: This ability to recognize that a shape will need to be turned in a specific direction before it will fit is called an “allocentric frame of reference”.
ex.t: 这种识别形状需要朝特定方向旋转才能放入的能力被称为"异中心参照系"。

ex.s: We prefer to describe emotional intelligence as a specific set of skills that can be used for either good or bad purposes.
ex.t: 我们更倾向于将情商描述为一组特定的技能，可以用于好的或坏的目的。

ex.s: They can be directed onto a specific area.
ex.t: 它们可以被导向特定区域。

ex.s: Today, the usage has no connection to China, nor any specific political connection.
ex.t: 如今，这种用法与中国没有任何联系，也没有任何具体的政治联系。

ex.s: Apparently, the idea of money that's not tied to a specific bank — or a specific country — is appealing to many.
ex.t: 显然，不与特定银行——或特定国家——绑定的货币概念对许多人很有吸引力。

ex.s: Taken informally, the budget line describes the boundary of affordability for a given budget and specific goods.
ex.t: 从非正式角度看，预算线描述的是给定预算和特定商品下的支付能力边界。

ex.s: It is limitation of affordability for a given budget and specific goods.
ex.t: 它是对给定预算和特定商品的可承受能力的限制。

ex.s: Machines with specific purposes are associated with living things partly because they might be able to        .
ex.t: 有特定用途的机器之所以与生物相关联，部分是因为它们或许能够____。

ex.s: When scanning a text, you read it quickly in order to find a specific piece of information.
ex.t: 在扫描一个文本时，您会快速读取，以便找到一个特定的信息片段。

ex.s: By doing this, the storyteller does not have to make references to a specific culture.
ex.t: 通过这样做，讲故事的人不必引用特定的文化。

ex.s: Today, on an island in the Pacific, a specific type of shell still serves as currency — and some people there are even hoarding it, just like Bitcoin moguls, convinced that one day, it will make them wealthy beyond imagination.
ex.t: 今天，在太平洋的一个岛屿上，一种特定的贝壳仍然作为货币使用——有些人甚至囤积它，就像比特币模具一样，相信有一天，它将使他们变得富有，超越想象。

ex.s: A machine with a specific purpose has another quality, one that we usually associate with living things: a wish to preserve its own existence.
ex.t: 一台有特定用途的机器还有另一种品质，一种我们通常与生物联系在一起的品质：保全自身存在的愿望。

ex.s: Daji, or big open-air fairs, typically take place on specific dates of the lunar calendar, for example, on dates with five or seven as the last digit.
ex.t: 大集，即大型露天集市，通常在农历特定日子举行，例如尾数为五或七的日期。

ex.s: They will sniff out specific areas before they choose a place to relax.
ex.t: 它们在选择一个地方放松之前，会先嗅探特定区域。

defs.def: existing only in one place or limited to one thing 特有的；独特的
